description: Precision multi-fiber MT ferrule family offered in multiple performance grades for application and fiber-count requirements. US Conec supplies single-mode and multimode versions in Standard, MT Elite® and Super MT Elite® selections, including APC/PC and flat/pre-angle configurations.

__characteristics__.name: MT Ferrules
__characteristics__.description: PPS-based precision multi-fiber ferrules with up to 72 fiber holes for 125 µm optical fiber. Alignment uses two stainless guide pins in precision-molded guide holes. Designed for MTP®/MPO connectivity and custom passive/active optical coupling; MT Elite® variants target lower-loss applications.

specs.Performance Grades: Standard / MT Elite® / Super MT Elite®
specs.Fiber Types: Multimode / Multimode Elite / Single-mode / Single-Mode Elite / Super Elite
specs.Fiber Count Options: 1×12 / 1×16 / 2×12 / 4×12 / 6×12; catalog family up to 72 fiber holes
specs.Material: Composite PPS thermoplastic; low hygroscopic material
specs.Alignment: Two stainless-steel guide pins in precision-molded alignment holes
specs.Standards / Applications: IEC 61754-5; MTP®/MPO assemblies; custom passive/active coupling; MT Elite MM optimized for 10G/40G/100G/400G
